title: Simpler plans
brief:
An issue of Orbit's newsletter, The Orbit Dispatch, made with Orbit's newsletter kit (see CLAUDE.md for its rules).

- Preview text: "One plan for teams, and a free one for everyone else."
- Heading: "Simpler plans"
- Intro: "We've folded five plans into two, and nobody pays more."
- Two stories, one after the other. Each is an image, a title, a sentence and a button:
  - Image https://assets.orbit.dev/img/gradient.png (1200×500 file), alt text "The two new plans". Title "Two plans, no surprises". Text "Free for you, one price per seat for your team.". Button "See the plans" to https://orbit.dev/pricing?utm_source=newsletter.
  - Image https://assets.orbit.dev/img/hyper-elements-overview.png (1672×941 file), alt text "Orbit for large teams". Title "For larger teams". Text "Single sign-on, audit logs and a person to call.". Button "Book a demo" to https://orbit.dev/demo?utm_source=newsletter.
- Orbit's header (the logo) and footer (the address, and the unsubscribe link) are the kit's: use them as they are.
